name: hyperqualia
title: hyperqualia
blurb: a real hyperplane slice through a rotating tesseract, computed live off its actual rotated edges — the 4D object never renders directly, only the 3D cross-section, standing in for @fubarchitect.com's line that mind-facing output is higher dimensional and narrative is just the accessible slice. a scatter of hyperqualia inducers (breathwork, ayahuasca, dance, dmt, prayer...) only enter the slice, and the scrolling narrative line, when the plane actually reaches them.
